commit_message: GATE-00: gate infrastructure — verify-gate.ts, CI workflow, MILESTONES.md
scope_completed: Fixed every failing unit/architecture test (prior corrective PRs cce207f, 4946b51, 1f6ad58)
test:unit has no network, database, process, or browser dependency (uses only node:fs, node:child_process for git ls-files, node:path)

test:arch has no network, database, localhost, mesh, or web-server dependency (uses only @reference/ pure protocol core + node:fs static file reads; gateway check #13 is a static source-text scan, not a runtime import)
test:integration:mesh owns all sockets/processes (test #25 moved entirely to integration-mesh-tests.ts; never runs in test:arch)
All conformance vectors are valid JSON (V-NODEID-001, V-NODEID-002, V-NODEID-003, V-CBOR-001)
Secret scanner covers all tracked files semantically (context-aware patterns: JSON fields, TS properties, dot-access assignments, body extraction; not prose mentions)
bun install --frozen-lockfile, lint, unit, architecture tests all complete in a clean checkout
Created tools/verify-gate.ts with 6 checks: valid JSON vectors, no secret material, gate evidence, no skipped-as-passed, no localhost/DB in unit/arch tests, no forbidden transitions
Created .github/workflows/ci.yml CI workflow running all gate checks
Created MILESTONES.md tracking all gates GATE-00..GATE-13
commands_run: JSON parse validation for every conformance/vectors/*.json
protocol_adr_references: ADR-0001 (local dev SQLite substitution — NOT superseded)
ADR-0013 (three-layer separation: web auth / service / protocol)
ADR-0016 (link handshake replay defect + transcript binding — PROPOSAL, not implemented)
known_limitations: GATE-01 is BLOCKED: requires an independent Python verifier consuming the same conformance vectors (no such implementation exists yet)
GATE-03 is BLOCKED: requires Principal Architect approval of ADR-0016 (3-message transcript-binding handshake) before LINK_UP can be achieved
The current two-message exchange establishes ADV_VERIFIED only, NOT LINK_UP (per spec/04 §4 corrected state machine)
No reproducible database migrations exist (prisma db push is used, not prisma migrate); the schema is a local development substitution (ADR-0001)
No cross-language conformance is claimed (only one TypeScript implementation exists)
The node-link mini-services are local-only (localhost TCP); no real Internet gateway forwarding exists (Phase 8 / GATE-07)
